proactive_recommendations.title: Add sameAs links to the Organization schema
proactive_recommendations.rationale: An Organization node is present on 3 of 3 crawled pages but declares no sameAs property, so the site links to no independent profile (LinkedIn, Crunchbase, GitHub, a registry listing). Assistants weight a fact more heavily when several unrelated sources agree on it; right now the only source asserting this entity is the site itself.

proactive_recommendations.title: Declare what the business sells with Service, Product or Offer schema
proactive_recommendations.rationale: Across 3 crawled pages the only schema.org types present are: AboutPage, BreadcrumbList, ListItem, Organization, Person, PostalAddress. None of Service, Product or Offer appears, so nothing on the site states machine-readably what is actually being offered. A page describing each service with Service or Offer markup gives an assistant a structured answer to "what do they do".

proactive_recommendations.title: Complete the postal address and add a contactPoint
proactive_recommendations.rationale: The PostalAddress node carries only addressCountry; the Organization node has no contactPoint, telephone or email. "Where are they based" and "how do I contact them" are among the most common entity questions asked of assistants, and neither is currently answerable from the site's own structured data.

proactive_recommendations.title: Give key people their own resolvable Person entity
proactive_recommendations.rationale: Rohit Pardeshi appears only as a nested property inside another node, never as a standalone Person entity with its own url and sameAs links. Nested people are frequently dropped during entity resolution, so the person and the brand are not connected in the way an assistant can follow.

proactive_recommendations.title: Publish an llms.txt orientation file
proactive_recommendations.rationale: No /llms.txt was found. The file is a short, machine-readable index pointing crawlers at the canonical pages for the brand rather than making them infer structure from navigation. Adoption is still emerging, but the cost is a single static file.

proactive_recommendations.title: Add a changelog or insights section that updates on a real cadence
proactive_recommendations.rationale: No dateModified or datePublished appears in any structured data block, and no blog, news or changelog section exists among the pages found. Nothing signals that the site is actively maintained. A genuinely-updated page is the honest way to create that signal — padding dateModified on static pages is detectable and counterproductive. Coverage: the sitemap lists 3 URLs.

proactive_recommendations.title: Add a comparison or alternatives page
proactive_recommendations.rationale: No comparison, versus or alternatives page was found. Comparison queries are among the highest-volume prompts assistants receive. When a brand does not publish its own comparison, assistants fall back to third-party review sites and competitor pages — which get cited instead, and frame the comparison unfavourably. Coverage: the sitemap lists 3 URLs.

proactive_recommendations.title: Publish case studies or a named-clients page
proactive_recommendations.rationale: No case-study, customer or portfolio page was found. Named engagements are the most reusable corroboration a B2B site can create: they give other sites something specific to reference, and they answer "who actually uses this" — a question assistants are asked constantly and currently cannot answer from this domain. Coverage: the sitemap lists 3 URLs.
